question.text: A container is divided into two chambers by a partition. The volume of first chamber is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>litre</mi></math> and second chamber is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>litre</mi></math>. The first chamber contain <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn></math> moles of gas at pressure <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn><mo> </mo><mi>atm</mi></math> and second chamber contain <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn></math> moles of gas at pressure <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn><mo> </mo><mi>atm</mi></math>. After the partition is removed and the mixture attains equilibrium, then, the common equilibrium pressure existing in the mixture is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi>atm</mi></math>. Value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> (nearest integer) is <u>             </u>

solution.text:
Let common equilibrium pressure of mixture is P atmp. then

f2P1 V1+f2P2 V2=f2PV1+V2

f224.5+f235.5=f2P4.5+5.5

⇒P=2.55=x×10-1 atmp

So x=25.5≈26 (Nearest integer)
